title: Unity Assembly Definition
description: A Unity assembly definition (.asmdef): the scripts of its folder compile into one assembly.

name.description: The assembly name, unique in the project (Company.Product.Feature).

rootNamespace.description: The namespace new scripts in this assembly get.

references.description: Assemblies this one uses: their names, or "GUID:<guid>" references to their .asmdef files.

includePlatforms.description: Platforms the assembly is built for; empty means all (minus excludePlatforms). Use ["Editor"] for editor code.

excludePlatforms.description: Platforms the assembly is not built for (only when includePlatforms is empty).

overrideReferences.description: Reference only the precompiled assemblies of precompiledReferences instead of all of them.

precompiledReferences.description: Precompiled assemblies (.dll file names) to reference when overrideReferences is on.

autoReferenced.description: Whether the predefined assemblies (Assembly-CSharp) reference this assembly automatically.

defineConstraints.description: Scripting symbols that must be defined (or, with a leading !, undefined) for the assembly to compile, e.g. UNITY_INCLUDE_TESTS.

versionDefines.description: Symbols defined when a package or module is present in a version range.

noEngineReferences.description: Do not reference the UnityEngine and UnityEditor assemblies.

optionalUnityReferences.description: Deprecated (Unity 2019.2 and older): ["TestAssemblies"] made a test assembly.
